title: Edit Flows: Flow Matching with Edit Operations
tldr_zh: 在整条序列空间上定义 CTMC，转移=插入/删除/替换，经辅助对齐过程+Bregman 散度损失可训练，原生支持变长生成
tldr_en: CTMC over full sequence space with insert/delete/substitute transitions; trained via auxiliary alignment process and Bregman divergence loss; natively supports variable-length generation
